name: support_thread
title: Support thread next action
description: Given a customer support conversation, decide whether it is resolved, whether to escalate, and the customer's mood.
writes: a customer support conversation of 3-8 turns between a customer and one or more agents

fields.account: the customer's plan and any relevant status, 1-2 lines
fields.thread: the conversation, one turn per line, newest last

labels.yes: the customer's problem is solved and they are not waiting on anything
labels.no: still open or the customer is waiting

ask: Should this be escalated to a senior agent or manager?

labels.yes: stuck, repeated contact, or an angry or high-value customer
labels.no: a normal interaction the current agent can handle
